score_basis: Subjective bounded engineering assessment; overall browser estimate unchanged and not a numerical WPT-parity formula.
decision: Accept native dataURL decoding and metadata repair after independent native, browser navigation and unchanged WPT controls.
changes: Byte-length percent-decoding retains embedded NUL in plain bodies.
Infra forgiving-base64 accepts specified ASCII whitespace and absent padding but rejects malformed padding, URL-safe alphabet and invalid bytes.
Fragment exclusion, trailing case-insensitive base64 marker and dataURL-only MIME parsing/serialization follow Fetch/MIME algorithms.
cleanup: Real sealed-guard events complete; owned profiles/processes drained; source and binaries unchanged during gates.

resources.caveat: Process samples can miss short-lived children; RSS can double-count shared mappings.

limits: The three gains are unchanged upstream navigation subtests, not the70 native or18 authored controls.
Nine URLs are a focused cohort, not full WPT.
Broad native rerun and additional encoding/sizing work remain active.
